item.title: Avoid even small late payments… Do not exceed half of your credit card limit (소액이라도 연체 금물…카드 한도 절반 넘기지 마세요)
item.description:
How should you manage your credit score? Your personal credit score is calculated on a scale from 1 to 1,000 by personal credit rating agencies (CBs) such as NICE Information Service (NICE) and Korea Credit Bureau (KCB), based on various credit information. Since 2021, a scoring system has replaced the previous credit rating system. A higher score indicates a borrower less likely to default in the future. Banks and card companies use this score to determine loan eligibility, loan limits, interest rates, and credit card issuance. (신용점수는 어떻게 관리하는 것이 좋을까. 개인 신용점수는 나이스평가정보(NICE), 코리아크레딧뷰로(KCB) 같은 개인신용평가회사(CB)가 각종 신용정보를 바탕으로 1점부터 1000점까지 산정한다. 2021년부터 신용등급제 대신 점수제가 도입됐다. 점수가 높을수록 향후 연체 가능성이 낮은 차주로 평가된다. 은행과 카드사는 이 점수를 참고해 대출 가능 여부, 대출 한도와 금리, 신용카드 발급 여부 등을 판단한다.)

The most important principle identified by experts is “do not default, even on small amounts.” If you fail to pay credit card bills, loan interest, or telecommunications fees on time, it is reflected in your credit score. If the overdue period exceeds five business days and the amount is 100,000 won or more, financial institutions send the delinquency information to credit rating agencies. Even if you repay the amount later, the delinquency record remains for a certain period. (전문가들이 꼽는 가장 중요한 원칙은 “소액이라도 연체하지 말라”는 것이다. 카드값이나 대출 이자, 통신요금 등을 제때 내지 못하면 신용점수에 반영된다. 연체 기간이 5영업일 이상이고 금액이 10만원 이상이면 금융사는 연체 정보를 신용평가사에 보낸다. 나중에 돈을 갚아도 연체 기록은 일정 기간 남는다.)

Besides avoiding defaults, building a consistent credit transaction history is equally important. Young adults new to the workforce often think “not taking out loans is better for my credit score,” but that is not the case. This is because factors such as whether you have paid credit card bills and loan principal and interest on time, how long you have maintained credit transactions, your current debt burden, and how you use credit and debit cards are all considered together. Having too little credit transaction history, known as being a “thin filer,” can also be disadvantageous for your evaluation. (연체를 피하는 것만큼 꾸준한 신용거래 이력을 쌓는 일도 중요하다. 사회초년생일수록 ‘대출을 안 받으면 신용점수에 유리하다’고 생각하기 쉽지만, 그렇지 않다. 카드값과 대출 원리금을 제때 갚았는지, 신용거래를 얼마나 오래 이어왔는지, 현재 빚 부담은 어느 정도인지, 신용카드와 체크카드를 어떻게 쓰는지 등이 함께 반영되기 때문이다. 신용거래 이력이 너무 적은 이른바 ‘신 파일러’(thin filer)도 평가에 불리할 수 있다.)

Loans from secondary financial sectors like savings banks and mutual finance institutions often carry higher interest rates than bank loans, which can lead to a larger drop in your credit score. This is because higher interest rates increase the likelihood of being classified as high-risk loans. Repeatedly taking out small loans from multiple financial companies or using credit card revolving services, cash advances, and card loans can be interpreted as a sign of high demand for quick cash, negatively affecting your score. (저축은행·상호금융 등 2금융권 대출은 은행 대출보다 금리가 높은 경우가 많아 신용점수 하락 폭이 더 클 수 있다. 금리가 높을수록 고위험 대출로 분류될 가능성이 크기 때문이다. 여러 금융회사에서 소액 대출을 반복하거나 신용카드 리볼빙, 현금서비스, 카드론을 이용하는 것도 급전 수요가 크다는 신호로 해석돼 점수에 부정적으로 작용할 수 있다.)

When it comes to credit cards, how you use them is more important than how many you have. Just having multiple cards does not lower your score. Managing your credit limit is more crucial. Experts recommend using only 40-50% or less of your credit card limit, and it is also advisable not to max out your overdraft accounts. A history of consistently using credit and debit cards without late payments is a factor that can boost your score. (신용카드는 발급 장수보다 사용 방식이 더 중요하다. 여러 장을 갖고 있다는 이유만으로 점수가 떨어지지 않는다. 한도 관리가 더 중요하다. 전문가들은 카드 한도의 40~50% 이하 수준에서 사용하는 것을 추천하며, 마이너스통장 역시 한도를 가득 채워 쓰지 않는 편이 이롭다. 신용카드와 체크카드를 연체 없이 꾸준히 사용한 이력은 점수 상승 요인이다.)

If you lack a financial transaction history, you can also utilize non-financial information. Submitting payment information for National Pension, health insurance premiums, telecommunications fees, and public utility charges to credit rating agencies can be reflected in your score calculation. The “Raise Credit Score” feature often seen in financial apps operates in this way. However, this is more of a means to supplement a sparse financial history rather than a secret method to drastically boost your score in a short period. (금융거래 이력이 부족하다면 비금융 정보를 활용하는 방법도 있다. 국민연금, 건강보험료, 통신요금, 공공요금 등 납부 정보를 신용평가사에 제출하면 점수 산정에 반영될 수 있다. 금융 앱에서 흔히 볼 수 있는 ‘신용점수 올리기’ 기능이 이런 방식이다. 다만 단기간에 점수를 크게 끌어올리는 비법이라기보다는 부족한 금융 이력을 보완하는 수단에 가깝다.)

Reporter An Tae-ho eco@hani.co.kr (안태호 기자 eco@hani.co.kr)

item.title: The Driving Force of Future Cars Is Software… Industry Engages in Fierce Hegemony Competition (미래차 원동력은 소프트웨어…업계, 치열한 패권 경쟁)
item.description:
The automotive industry cites "Software-Defined Vehicles" (SDVs) as the core of future car competitiveness, but the methods for implementing this in new models vary by company. While some companies lead with artificial intelligence (AI) assistants that read the driver's words and situations, others emphasize integrated control of vehicle movement or software development platforms. (자동차 업계가 미래차 경쟁력의 핵심으로 ‘소프트웨어 중심 자동차’(SDV)를 꼽고 있지만, 신차에서 이를 구현하는 방식은 회사마다 달랐다. 운전자의 말과 상황을 읽는 인공지능(AI) 비서를 앞세우는 회사가 있는가 하면, 차량 움직임의 통합 제어나 소프트웨어 개발 플랫폼을 앞세우는 곳도 있었다.)

SDVs do not simply refer to cars equipped with large displays or artificial intelligence. They are vehicles that separate the development cycles of hardware and software, connecting everything from the vehicle and computing platform to software, data, applications, and services, allowing for improvements in functionality and performance even after delivery. (에스디브이는 단순히 큰 디스플레이나 인공지능이 적용된 차를 뜻하지 않는다. 하드웨어와 소프트웨어의 개발 주기를 분리하고, 차량·컴퓨팅 플랫폼부터 소프트웨어·데이터, 애플리케이션과 서비스까지 연결해 출고 뒤에도 기능과 성능을 개선할 수 있는 자동차다.)

According to a compilation of reports from The Hankyoreh on the 22nd, domestic automakers and imported car brands are sequentially unveiling new models that concretize the transition to SDVs. The core of BMW Korea's all-electric sports utility vehicle (SUV), the New iX3, set for domestic launch on July 6, is the four high-performance computers called "Superbrains." Among these, the "Heart of Joy" integrates and controls driving, braking, steering, and body stabilization functions. This enables faster and more natural vehicle responses during acceleration, deceleration, and cornering. The change in software is thus experienced in driving feel, beyond just screens and content. (22일 한겨레 취재를 종합하면, 최근 국내 완성차 업체와 수입차 브랜드는 에스디브이 전환을 구체화한 신차를 잇달아 선보이고 있다. 베엠베(BMW)코리아가 7월6일 국내 출시할 순수 전기 스포츠유틸리티차(SUV) 더 뉴 아이엑스(iX)3의 핵심은 4개의 고성능 컴퓨터 ‘슈퍼브레인’이다. 이 가운데 ‘하트 오브 조이’는 구동과 제동, 조향, 차체 안정화 기능을 하나로 묶어 제어한다. 이를 통해 가속·감속과 코너링 때 차량이 더 빠르고 자연스럽게 반응하도록 했다. 소프트웨어의 변화가 화면과 콘텐츠를 넘어 주행감으로 체감된 것이다.)

The core of Toyota's SDV strategy, showcased with the all-new RAV4 launched on the 16th, is the next-generation software development platform "Aren." Its key feature is the integration of development platforms and data that previously varied by function, allowing Toyota and its partners to work with the same information and system. Based on this, "Toyota Connect" offers localized services for the Korean market, such as navigation and content services in collaboration with LG Uplus, as well as remote start and climate control functions. (토요타가 지난 16일 출시한 올 뉴 라브(RAV)4를 통해 선보인 에스디브이 전략의 핵심은 차세대 소프트웨어 개발 플랫폼 ‘아린’이다. 기능마다 달랐던 개발 플랫폼과 데이터를 통합해 토요타와 협력업체가 같은 정보와 체계로 작업하도록 한 것이 특징이다. 이를 바탕으로 한 ‘토요타 커넥트’는 엘지유플러스와 협업한 내비게이션·콘텐츠 서비스와 원격 시동·공조 기능 등 한국시장 맞춤형 서비스를 제공한다.)

Hyundai Motor applied "Pleos Connect" and the voice assistant "Gleos AI" for the first time in the New Grandeur launched on the 14th of last month, leading with infotainment centered on a 17-inch central display and context-aware AI services. For example, upon receiving the command "Only turn mine off," it determines the speaking location and active functions to turn off only the ventilation for that specific seat. (현대차는 지난달 14일 출시한 더 뉴 그랜저에 ‘플레오스 커넥트’와 음성 비서 ‘글레오 에이아이’를 처음 적용해, 17인치 중앙 디스플레이를 중심으로 한 인포테인먼트와 맥락 인식형 인공지능 서비스를 앞세웠다. “나만 꺼줘”라는 명령에 발화 위치와 작동 중인 기능을 판단해 해당 좌석의 통풍만 끄는 식이다.)

Additionally, Volvo Cars focused on improving safety and performance through wireless updates in the electric SUV EX90. Mercedes-Benz emphasized the integration of vehicle functions by first applying its own operating system "MB.OS" in the CLA. Renault plans to apply the SDV design structure developed by its electric vehicle and software subsidiary, Ampere, to electric commercial vehicles, enabling automatic updates and remote diagnostics. (이밖에 볼보자동차는 전기 에스유브이 이엑스(EX)90에서 무선 업데이트를 통해 안전·성능을 개선하는 데 무게를 뒀다. 메르세데스-벤츠는 시엘에이(CLA)에 자체 운영체제 ‘엠비오에스’(MB.OS)를 처음 적용해 차량 기능을 통합한 것을 강조했다. 르노는 그룹의 전기차·소프트웨어 자회사 암페어가 개발한 에스디브이 설계구조를 전기 상용차에 적용해 자동 업데이트와 원격 진단을 구현할 계획이다.)

Although the face of SDVs visible to consumers differs, autonomous driving combined with artificial intelligence is identified as the biggest battleground that will determine industry leadership. The McKinsey Center for Future Mobility forecasts that the market for Advanced Driver-Assistance Systems (ADAS) and autonomous driving software will grow from $9 billion in 2025 to $50 billion in 2035, becoming the largest segment of the functional automotive software market after 2030. (소비자에게 보이는 에스디브이의 얼굴은 다르지만, 산업 주도권을 가를 최대 승부처로는 인공지능을 결합한 자율주행이 꼽힌다. 맥킨지 미래 모빌리티 센터는 첨단운전자보조시스템(ADAS)·자율주행 소프트웨어 시장이 2025년 90억달러에서 2035년 500억달러로 커져, 2030년 이후 기능별 자동차 소프트웨어 시장 중 최대 규모가 될 것으로 전망했다.)

Professor Kim Pil-soo of Daelim University (Department of Future Automotive Engineering) stated, "Ultimately, autonomous driving integrated with AI is the core," adding that infotainment and AI voice assistants are "plus alpha." He pointed out that if companies fail to establish their own SDV systems within the next two to three years, they will become dependent on algorithms from Chinese and American companies and may even lose control over collected data. He said, "Ultimately, algorithm independence will determine future car competitiveness." (김필수 대림대 교수(미래자동차공학부)는 “결국 인공지능을 융합한 자율주행이 핵심”이라며 인포테인먼트, 인공지능 음성 비서 등은 “플러스 알파”라고 말했다. 김 교수는 앞으로 2~3년 안에 독자적인 에스디브이 체계를 갖추지 못하면 중국·미국 기업의 알고리즘에 의존하게 되고, 수집 데이터의 주도권까지 내줄 수 있다고 지적했다. 그는 “결국 알고리즘의 독립이 미래차 경쟁력을 좌우할 것”이라고 말했다.)

Reporter Yoo Ha-young yhy@hani.co.kr (유하영 기자 yhy@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Duksung Women’s University Achieves Excellent Results in the 6th Cycle Teacher Training Institution Competency Assessment (덕성여대, 제6주기 교원양성기관 역량진단서 우수 성과 달성)
item.description:
Duksung Women’s University (President Min Jae-hong) has achieved excellent results in the ‘6th Cycle Teacher Training Institution Competency Assessment’ conducted by the Ministry of Education and the Korea Educational Development Institute. In this assessment, the Department of Early Childhood Education at Duksung Women’s University received the ‘Highest’ grade, while the Division of Teacher Education obtained the ‘Excellent’ grade, and the Graduate School of Education also received favorable evaluations in fields such as Counseling Psychology. (덕성여자대학교(총장 민재홍)는 교육부와 한국교육개발원이 주관한 ‘제6주기 교원양성기관 역량진단’에서 우수한 성과를 달성했다. 이번 진단에서 덕성여대 유아교육과는 ‘최우수’ 등급을, 교직학부는 ‘우수’ 등급을 획득했으며, 교육대학원도 상담심리 등 분야에서 우수한 평가를 받았다.)

The 6th Cycle Teacher Training Institution Competency Assessment is a system that comprehensively evaluates nationwide teacher training institutions on curriculum operation, practical training, educational environment, and student support systems. Through this evaluation, Duksung Women’s University once again earned recognition for its educational capabilities as a teacher training institution that cultivates both the professionalism and character of prospective teachers. (제6주기 교원양성기관 역량진단은 전국 교원양성기관을 대상으로 교육과정 운영, 실습교육, 교육환경, 학생 지원 체계 등을 종합적으로 평가하는 제도다. 덕성여대는 이번 평가를 통해 예비교사의 전문성과 인성을 함께 길러내는 교원양성기관으로서의 교육 역량을 다시 한번 인정받았다.)

In particular, the Department of Early Childhood Education received high marks for its systematic curriculum operation for training kindergarten teachers and the substantial improvement of practice-oriented education. The continuous expansion and enhancement of educational facilities, such as mock teaching practice rooms, microteaching rooms, and smart classrooms, along with the establishment of a support system for prospective teachers linked with the Human Rights Center and Psychological Support Center, were also positively assessed. (특히 유아교육과는 유치원 교원 양성을 위한 체계적인 교육과정 운영과 실습 중심 교육의 내실화에서 높은 평가를 받았다. 모의수업실습실, 마이크로티칭룸, 스마트 강의실 등 교육환경을 지속적으로 확충·개선해 온 점과 인권센터·심리지원센터를 연계한 예비교사 지원 체계를 구축한 점도 긍정적으로 평가됐다.)

Duksung Women’s University has operated a dedicated teacher education office since 1970, running specialized teacher training programs centered on full-time faculty in education studies. Currently, it trains secondary school teachers across 14 majors and kindergarten teachers through the Department of Early Childhood Education, while the Graduate School of Education offers various programs, including nutrition education training, early childhood education, counseling psychology retraining courses, counseling and psychotherapy, and child and family counseling. (덕성여대는 1970년부터 교직전담부서를 설치하고 교육학 전임 교수진을 중심으로 전문화된 교원양성과정을 운영해 왔다. 현재 14개 전공에서 중등교원을, 유아교육과에서는 유치원 교원을 양성하고 있으며, 교육대학원에서는 영양교육 양성과정을 비롯해 유아교육, 상담심리 재교육 과정, 상담및심리치료, 아동가족상담 등 다양한 교육과정을 운영하고 있다.)

Dean of the Graduate School, Yoon Hee-cheol, who oversaw this evaluation, stated, “Duksung Women’s University has maintained a tuition return rate of over 190% in recent years, ensuring stable educational conditions, and has systematically organized the structures and systems related to teacher training, rigorously managing qualification acquisition.” He added, “This achievement is the result of external recognition of the professionalism in teacher training and the educational support system that Duksung Women’s University has accumulated over a long period.” (이번 평가를 총괄한 윤희철 대학원장은 “덕성여대는 최근 190% 이상의 교육비 환원율을 유지하며 안정적인 교육 여건을 마련해 왔고, 교원양성과 관련한 조직과 제도를 체계적으로 정비해 자격 취득 관리를 철저히 수행하고 있다”며 “이번 성과는 덕성여대가 오랜 기간 축적해 온 교원양성의 전문성과 교육 지원 체계가 대외적으로 인정받은 결과”라고 말했다.)

President Min Jae-hong said, “This achievement reflects Duksung Women’s University’s consistent efforts to nurture prospective teachers with a balanced focus on professionalism, character, and field response capabilities.” He further stated, “Going forward, we will continue to innovate the curriculum and enhance practical training infrastructure to cultivate creative and convergent teachers who can actively respond to the rapidly changing educational landscape.” (민재홍 총장은 “이번 성과는 덕성여대가 예비교사의 전문성, 인성, 현장 대응 역량을 균형 있게 길러내기 위해 꾸준히 노력해 온 결과”라며 “앞으로도 급변하는 교육 현장에 능동적으로 대응할 수 있는 창의적이고 융합적인 교원 양성을 위해 교육과정 혁신과 실습 인프라 고도화를 지속해 나가겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Based on the outcomes of this 6th Cycle Teacher Training Institution Competency Assessment, Duksung Women’s University plans to further strengthen the internal quality of teacher training education and strive to produce outstanding teachers equipped with the professionalism and sense of responsibility demanded by future educational settings. (덕성여대는 이번 제6주기 교원양성기관 역량진단 성과를 바탕으로 교원양성 교육의 내실을 더욱 강화하고, 미래 교육 현장이 요구하는 전문성과 책임감을 갖춘 우수 교원 양성에 힘쓸 계획이다.)

item.title: Kookmin University Student Design Project ‘INSPO’ Wins Red Dot Award: Design Concept 2026 (국민대 학생 디자인 프로젝트 ‘INSPO’, Red Dot Award: Design Concept 2026 수상)
item.description:
The project ‘INSPO’, featuring Kang Ha-neul (Industrial Design, Class of 21) and Lee Min-seo (Industrial Design, Class of 20) from the College of Design at Kookmin University (President Jeong Seung-ryeol), has won an award in the Red Dot Award: Design Concept 2026, a prestigious international design competition. (국민대학교(총장 정승렬) 조형대학 강하늘 학생(공업디자인 21)과 이민서 학생(공업디자인 20)이 참여한 프로젝트 ‘INSPO’가 세계적인 디자인 공모전인 Red Dot Award: Design Concept 2026에서 수상했다.)

The Red Dot Award is one of the world’s top three design awards, alongside the IDEA in the United States and the iF Design Award in Germany. Among its categories, the Design Concept segment focuses on discovering innovative ideas and future-oriented design concepts that have not yet been released to the market. (Red Dot Award는 미국의 IDEA, 독일의 iF 디자인 어워드와 함께 세계 3대 디자인상으로 꼽히는 국제 디자인 공모전이다. 이 가운데 Design Concept 부문은 아직 시장에 출시되지 않은 혁신적인 아이디어와 미래지향적 디자인 콘셉트를 발굴하는 분야다.)

‘INSPO’ was first introduced in the spring of 2025 during an exhibition jointly planned by the product design club ‘ZAPPERS’ from the Department of Industrial Design and the product design club ‘ADD’ from Konkuk University. This award is significant as it recognizes design ideas developed by students through departmental club activities and exhibitions at an international design competition. (‘INSPO’는 지난 2025년 봄 공업디자인학과 제품디자인 동아리 ‘ZAPPERS’와 건국대학교 제품디자인 동아리 ‘ADD’가 연합해 기획한 전시에서 처음 선보인 프로젝트다. 이번 수상은 학생들이 학과 동아리 활동과 전시를 통해 발전시킨 디자인 아이디어가 국제 디자인 공모전에서 인정받았다는 점에서 의미가 있다.)

The ‘INSPO’ project is a smart insulin care solution for diabetic patients. Based on intuitive operation methods and lifestyle-centered design, it is designed to seamlessly integrate medical devices into daily life. In particular, it focuses on reducing the inconvenience diabetic patients experience in insulin management and transforming the medical device from a mere treatment tool into a product that reflects the user’s individuality and lifestyle. (프로젝트 ‘INSPO’는 당뇨 환자를 위한 스마트 인슐린 케어 솔루션이다. 직관적인 조작 방식과 라이프스타일 중심의 디자인을 바탕으로 의료기기가 일상에 자연스럽게 녹아들 수 있도록 설계됐다. 특히 당뇨 환자들이 인슐린 관리 과정에서 느끼는 불편함을 줄이고, 의료기기를 단순한 치료 도구가 아닌 사용자의 개성과 생활방식을 반영하는 제품으로 전환하는 데 초점을 맞췄다.)

Through this project, the students proposed that medical device design can play a role in reducing users’ psychological burden and helping them manage their health more naturally and confidently. This received high praise for its design approach, which goes beyond functionality and usability to consider user experience and emotional acceptance. (학생들은 이번 프로젝트를 통해 의료기기 디자인이 사용자의 심리적 부담을 줄이고, 건강관리를 보다 자연스럽고 자신 있게 이어갈 수 있도록 돕는 역할을 할 수 있음을 제안했다. 이는 기능성과 사용성을 넘어 사용자 경험과 감성적 수용성까지 고려한 디자인 접근이라는 점에서 좋은 평가를 받았다.)

This award is also connected to ‘KMU VISION 2035: EDGE,’ which Kookmin University declared as it celebrated its 80th anniversary. The university is strengthening creative problem-solving skills and convergent design education, focusing on the design & content field—one of eight specialized areas—and the ‘INSPO’ award can be seen as a case where this educational direction has led to students’ achievements in international design competitions. (이번 수상은 국민대가 개교 80주년을 맞아 선포한 ‘KMU VISION 2035: EDGE’와도 연결된다. 국민대는 8대 특성화 분야 중 하나인 디자인&콘텐츠 분야를 중심으로 창의적 문제 해결 역량과 융합형 디자인 교육을 강화하고 있으며, ‘INSPO’의 수상은 이러한 교육 방향이 학생들의 국제 디자인 공모전 성과로 이어진 사례로 볼 수 있다.)

Kang Ha-neul said, “During the preparation of the project, I put a lot of thought into the form, function, and usability. I am very pleased that the results have led to an award at a prestigious international competition.” (강하늘 학생은 “프로젝트를 준비하는 동안 조형과 기능, 사용성에 대해 많은 고민을 했다”며 “그 결과가 권위 있는 국제 공모전 수상으로 이어져 매우 기쁘다”고 말했다.)

Lee Min-seo shared her thoughts, saying, “In the process of completing the project and preparing the exhibition within a short time, we had many discussions with team members. The effort to complete the project in the desired direction has led to good results, making it meaningful.” (이민서 학생은 “짧은 시간 안에 프로젝트를 완성하고 전시를 준비하는 과정에서 팀원들과 많은 고민을 나눴다”며 “프로젝트를 원하는 방향으로 완성하기 위해 노력한 과정이 좋은 결과로 이어져 뜻깊다”고 소감을 전했다.)

(<이 기사는 대학이 제공한 정보기사로, 한겨레의 의견과 다를 수 있습니다>)

item.title: Bull Market is 'Another's Rice Cake'…6 out of 10 Stock Investors Hold Less Than 10 Million Won (불장은 ‘남의 떡’…주식투자 10명 중 6명 ‘1천만원 미만’ 보유)
item.description:
Office worker Park (33) has been investing in stocks for a year and a half. His initial seed money was 40 million won. He mainly invested in technology-based small-cap stocks, but his current return is -10%. He explains, "As funds are concentrated on Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, the stocks I bought are losing steam." He had planned to use stock profits to cover part of his wedding expenses, but with his plans going awry, he is even considering opening an overdraft account for the first time in his life. "News about the KOSPI rising comes out every day, but my account balance stays the same," he said. <<> Amid rosy forecasts that the KOSPI is heading towards the '10,000-point mark', it appears that over half of investors, like Park, are not feeling the warmth of the bull market. While the overall market pie has grown sharply in a short period, the benefits of the rally are becoming increasingly concentrated at the top. <<> According to data submitted by the Korea Securities Depository to the office of lawmaker Cha Kyu-geun of the Fatherland Innovation Party, as of the end of 2025, among 14.466 million individual investors in December fiscal year-end listed stock companies, 8.744 million, or 60.4% of the total, held stocks worth less than 10 million won. Of these, 4.433 million investors (30.7%) had less than 1 million won. In contrast, the total stock value held by this lower 60% was only 19.1776 trillion won, a mere 1.9% of the total holdings of 1014.4242 trillion won. This data is limited to December fiscal year-end companies and does not include beneficiary securities such as exchange-traded funds (ETFs), so the actual gap may be larger. <<> While the KOSPI surged 41% from 2,977 at the end of 2021 to 4,214 at the end of last year, most of the increase went to top-tier investors. The share of assets held by the top 1% of investors, those with stocks worth 500 million won or more, grew from 54.9% at the end of 2021 to 59.7% at the end of last year. Conversely, when combining investors in the two lowest brackets (under 50 million won), which account for 83.3% of all investors, they collectively hold only 9.8% of the total stock value. <<> The fruits of the stock market's growth have been concentrated among older and elderly generations. Stock assets of people in their 60s rose 55.5% from 170.3625 trillion won at the end of 2021 to 264.9786 trillion won at the end of 2025. This represents an increase of 94.6161 trillion won over four years, meaning that people in their 60s absorbed most of the market's total increase (about 101 trillion won). The holdings of those in their 50s, traditionally major players in the stock market, also increased by 24.6%, significantly exceeding the overall average growth rate of 12.6%. <<> In contrast, stock holdings of people in their 20s plummeted 22%, from 17.4786 trillion won to 13.6399 trillion won, marking the sharpest decline among all age groups. Holdings of those in their 30s also decreased by 6.6%, moving in the opposite direction to the market's growth trend. For those in their 40s, assets shrank by 14.1%, resulting in a reduction or outflow of over 33 trillion won from generations aged 40 and below. This reveals a 'generational wealth asymmetry' within the stock market. However, it should be noted that people in their 20s and 30s are relatively more active investors in overseas stocks and virtual assets. <<> Despite this concentration, tax equity in the financial sector is moving in reverse. Domestic capital gains tax on stocks applies to cases where an investor holds over 5 billion won worth of stocks in a single issue or meets a certain shareholding requirement (1% of KOSPI, 2% of KOSDAQ). Last year, the government attempted to expand the tax base for major shareholders from 5 billion won to 1 billion won per issue but retreated due to investor backlash. <<> Dividend income, which could be taxed at rates up to 45%, was also reformed last year to move toward tax cuts in order to revitalize the stock market. The 'separate taxation of dividend income' passed by the National Assembly at the end of last year allows dividend income from stocks to be taxed separately at a rate of 14% to 30%, without being aggregated into the comprehensive income tax base. Compared to the existing comprehensive taxation of financial income (max 45%), this effectively lowers the maximum tax rate by 15 percentage points. <<> It is estimated that this top-tier concentration has deepened in the first half of this year alone, as the KOSPI has more than doubled compared to year-end levels. Kim Hak-gyun, head of the Research Center at Shinyoung Securities, said, "During the 'three lows boom,' many industries grew together, but now, with semiconductor concentration exceeding 50%, the market is inevitably one where existing wealthy investors have the advantage," adding, "Discussions on utilizing excess tax revenue are inevitably important." <<> Reporters: Park Su-ji suji@hani.co.kr, Jo Hae-young hycho@hani.co.kr (직장인 박아무개(33)씨는 주식투자를 시작한 지 1년 반이 됐다. 투자 종잣돈은 4천만원. 기술 기반 스몰캡(소형주) 위주로 투자했지만 현재 수익률은 -10%다. “자금이 삼성전자, 하이닉스 위주로 몰리면서 내가 들어간 종목들이 힘을 못 받고 있다”는 게 그의 설명이다. 결혼을 앞두고 주식 수익금으로 결혼 비용 일부를 충당하려 했지만 계획이 어긋나면서, 생전 처음으로 마이너스통장 개설까지 고민하게 됐다. “코스피가 오른다는 뉴스는 매일 나오는데 내 계좌는 그대로”라고 그는 말했다.)

item.title: July Tax Reform Plan as a Touchstone: "Must Reduce Asset Gap by Normalizing Financial Investment and Property Taxes" (7월 세제 개편안이 시금석…“금투·보유세 정상화로 자산격차 완화해야”)
item.description:
Amid growing concerns over widening asset gaps fueled by a stock market boom driven by semiconductors and stimulus in the real estate market, voices are emerging calling for the re-introduction of the Financial Investment Income Tax (FIIT) and real estate tax reforms to ease disparities and ensure tax equity. The tax reform plan set to be announced at the end of next month is expected to serve as a touchstone for gauging the government's commitment to normalizing taxation. (반도체발 주식시장 활황과 부동산시장 자극으로 자산 격차 심화 우려가 커지는 가운데, 격차 완화와 조세 형평성을 위해 금융투자소득세(금투세) 재도입과 부동산 세제 개편이 필요하다는 목소리가 나온다. 다음달 말 발표될 세제 개편안이 정부의 과세 정상화 의지를 가늠할 시금석이 될 전망이다.)

As the KOSPI surpassed 9,000 points and hit an all-time high, discussions on reintroducing the FIIT are resurfacing. The FIIT is a system that comprehensively taxes profits and losses from financial investments. It was decided to be introduced in 2020 during the Moon Jae-in administration to enhance tax equity. Key provisions include applying a tax rate of 22–27.5% on combined income from financial products such as stocks and bonds exceeding 50 million won starting from 2023. However, its implementation was postponed after the Yoon Suk Yeol government took office, and it was abolished at the end of 2024 through a bipartisan agreement. <<> Chung Se-eun, a professor of economics at Chungnam National University, stated, "As the stock market rally has led to a concentration of more financial assets among those who already had substantial wealth, the failure to properly levy taxes is a serious issue in terms of fairness. Since market conditions are sufficiently ripe, the government must demonstrate policy commitment to the FIIT." <<> Regarding real estate, criticisms are raised that relatively low property holding taxes or excessive tax deductions for single-homeowners spur speculative demand for housing, exacerbating asset inequality. President Lee Jae-myung mentioned in a press conference marking his first year in office, "Our country's property holding taxes are generally low. There's little burden even if you accumulate many properties." He added, "In foreign countries, holding taxes are burdensome, so at some point, those who need them end up owning real estate." Presidential Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom posted on Facebook on the 20th, "Real estate taxation must be normalized. Adjusting property holding taxes and capital gains taxes reasonably is necessary and the right direction. If the national wealth generated by semiconductors is absorbed into real estate unearned income and the fruits of growth are concentrated on a minority, this boom will not last long." Accordingly, the tax reform plan to be announced at the end of next month is expected to include specific directions for real estate tax reforms. <<> First, plans to reform property holding taxes centered on the Comprehensive Real Estate Tax (CRET) are being discussed. A key example is the increase in the ratio of fair market value to public price, which is possible through enforcement decree amendments without legislative procedures. After deducting various exemptions from the public price of a home, multiplying by this ratio yields the tax base for the holding tax. Raising this ratio from the current 60% would effectively increase holding taxes without adjusting nominal tax rates. There are also mentions of further segmenting the CRET tax brackets to apply higher tax rates than currently on high-priced homes or raising nominal tax rates. <<> Reducing the Long-Term Holding Special Deduction (LTHSD) for capital gains tax on so-called "prime single-home" owners who do not reside in the property is also considered a viable option. Currently, if a single-homeowner sells a property they have owned and lived in for over 10 years, they can receive a combined deduction of up to 80%, with respective deduction rates of 40% for holding and residency periods. Given that the current non-taxation threshold for single-homeowner capital gains tax is up to 1.2 billion won, this tax benefit applies only to owners of high-priced homes. The government is considering reducing or abolishing deductions for mere holding and increasing benefits tied to actual residency periods. Kim Hyun-dong, a professor of business administration at Baekseok University, stated, "We need to break free from the mindset that single-homeowners must be unconditionally protected and revise excessive tax benefits." <<> Reporter Kim Yoon-joo kyj@hani.co.kr (코스피가 9천을 돌파하며 사상 최고치를 경신하자 금투세 재도입 논의가 다시 고개를 들고 있다. 금투세는 금융투자로 발생한 이익과 손실을 합산해 포괄적으로 과세하는 제도다. 2020년 문재인 정부 때 조세 형평성을 높이기 위해 도입하기로 결정했다. 2023년부터 주식·채권 등 금융상품 관련 합산 소득이 5천만원을 넘을 경우 22~27.5%의 세율을 적용하는 게 주요 내용이다. 그러나 윤석열 정부 출범 이후 도입이 유예됐고, 2024년 말 여야 합의로 폐지했다.)

item.title: Former Fed Chairman Alan Greenspan dies at 100 (앨런 그린스펀 전 연준 의장 별세…향년 100살)
item.description:
Alan Greenspan, the former chairman of the U.S. Federal Reserve often called the "Maestro," died on the 22nd (local time) from complications of Parkinson's disease, NBC News reported. He was 100. (‘마에스트로’로 일컬어지던 앨런 그린스펀 전 미국 연방준비제도(연준) 의장이 22일(현지시각) 파킨슨병 합병증으로 사망했다고 엔비시(NBC)뉴스가 이날 전했다. 향년 100.)

Greenspan was appointed by U.S. President Ronald Reagan in 1987 to lead the Fed and held the position for 18 years until his retirement in 2006. It was the second-longest tenure in the history of the U.S. Federal Reserve. During his term, he served under four presidents, including George W. Bush. (그린스펀은 1987년 로널드 레이건 미국 대통령의 지명으로 미 연준 의장에 오른 뒤 2006년 은퇴할 때까지 18년 동안 자리를 유지했다. 미 연준 역사상 두 번째로 긴 재직 기간이다. 임기 동안 거친 대통령이 조지 더블유(W) 부시까지 4명이었다.)

During his tenure, the U.S. economy achieved an unprecedented boom, earning him the nickname "Maestro" in global financial markets, a term meaning economic president or conductor of the world economy. He earned a Ph.D. in economics from New York University and, before entering public service, ran an economic consulting firm for about 32 years, where he is said to have grasped the workings of the market. (그의 재임 기간 미국 경제는 이례적인 경제 호황을 달성하는 바람에 그는 세계 금융시장에서 경제 대통령 또는 세계 경제의 지휘자라는 뜻에서 ‘마에스트로’라는 찬사를 받았다. 뉴욕대학교에서 경제학 박사 학위를 받은 그는 공직 입문 전 32년가량 경제 컨설팅 회사를 경영하며 시장의 생리를 체득했던 것으로 알려져 있다.)

He is credited with preemptively responding to numerous global economic crises, starting with the 1987 "Black Monday" stock market crash shortly after his inauguration, followed by the 1990s Asian financial crisis, the collapse of the dot-com bubble in the early 2000s, and the September 11, 2001 attacks, managing them effectively. (그는 취임 직후 발생한 1897년의 ‘블랙 먼데이’ 주가 폭락 사태를 시작으로, 1990년대 아시아 금융위기, 2000년대 닷컴 버블 붕괴, 2001년 9·11 테러까지 숱한 글로벌 경제 위기에 선제적으로 대응해 선방한 것으로 평가받는다.)

In his communication with financial markets, he was famous for using extremely vague and obscure language, making it difficult to reveal his precise intentions, coining the popular phrase "Greenspan's riddle." (금융시장을 상대로 한 소통에서 그는 극도로 모호하고 난해한 표현을 사용해 정확한 의도를 쉽게 드러내지 않는 것으로 유명해, ‘그린스펀의 수수께끼’라는 유행어를 낳을 정도였다.)

Despite his stellar achievements, a dark shadow loomed over his legacy. In the latter part of his tenure, his excessively low interest rate policies and deregulation of derivative financial products were criticized for triggering the 2008 global financial crisis and damaging the global financial system. He himself acknowledged during a U.S. congressional hearing that it was an error stemming from his belief in deregulation, which overestimated market capabilities. (화려한 업적 이면에는 어두운 그림자도 짙게 드리워져 있었다. 재임 후반기에 단행했던 지나친 초저금리 기조와 파생금융상품 규제 완화 중심의 통화 정책이 2008년 글로벌 금융위기를 촉발하고 세계 금융시스템을 망가뜨렸다는 비판을 피해가지 못했다. 그 또한 미국 의회 청문회에서 시장 능력을 과신했던 규제 완화 신념에서 비롯된 오류라고 인정했다.)

Kim Jin-il, a monetary policy board member at the Bank of Korea who worked as a senior economist at the U.S. Federal Reserve, described him as "a figure with both merits and faults who dominated an era." Kim added, "Despite being criticized for fostering the financial crisis, he sincerely apologized, and even though he could have served longer, he chose to step down at the end of his term—that was truly maestro-like." (미 연준에서 선임 이코노미스트로 일했던 김진일 한국은행 금융통화위원은 “공과 과가 있지만 한 시대를 풍미한 인물”이었다고 평했다. 김 위원은 “금융위기를 잉태했다는 비판을 받고 본인도 솔직히 사과했고, 임기 마지막에는 더 일할 수 있었음에도 스스로 그만둔 것도 마에스트로다웠다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Gangnam's Big 3 Sell Stocks and Real Estate, Nowon-Dobong-Gangbuk Buy Homes with Loans (강남3구는 주식·부동산 팔아, 노도강은 대출 받아 집 샀다)
item.description:
<<>> Seoul's housing market is becoming stratified into a "market where homes are bought with assets" and a "market where homes are bought with loans." In Seoul's Gangnam Big 3 districts (Gangnam, Seocho, and Songpa), the funds for home purchases came from the sale of existing properties, stocks, bonds, gifts, and inheritances, while in Nowon-Dobong-Gangbuk (Nowon, Dobong, and Gangbuk), mortgage loans accounted for the largest share. While wealthy individuals engage in purchasing high-priced homes in Gangnam's Big 3 districts, demand-driven buyers relying on mortgages are buying in Seoul's outer areas, meaning that the starting point for the "housing ladder" differs depending on asset ownership. ()

An analysis of fund procurement plans (excluding foreigners and corporations) submitted to the National Assembly by Rep. Cha Kyu-geun of the Fatherland Innovation Party and obtained from the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport on the 22nd shows that in Q1 of this year, the average home purchase price per household in Gangnam's Big 3 was approximately KRW 1.504 billion, while in Nowon-Dobong-Gangbuk it was KRW 564 million, a nearly threefold gap. The gap in transaction volume is just as stark as the difference in fund procurement methods, revealing a stratified market structure. Gangnam's Big 3 districts purchase more expensive homes based on assets they already own, essentially "trading up," whereas Nowon-Dobong-Gangbuk buy homes by relying on loans. (서울 주택시장이 ‘자산으로 집을 사는 시장’과 ‘대출로 집을 사는 시장’으로 계층화되고 있다. 서울 강남3구(강남·서초·송파구)의 주택 매수 자금은 기존 주택 처분 대금과 주식·채권 매각 대금, 증여·상속에서 나왔지만 노도강(노원·도봉·강북구)은 주택담보대출(주담대)이 가장 큰 비중을 차지했다. 자산가 계층이 강남3구 고가 주택 매입에 나서는 동안, 실수요자 중심의 추격 매수는 주담대를 끼고 서울 외곽 지역 매수에 나서는 셈인데, 자산 보유 여부에 따라 ‘주거 사다리’가 놓이는 출발선이 달라진다는 의미다.)

In Gangnam's Big 3, the use of various assets—not just real estate but also deposits and stocks—to purchase homes is clearly evident. In Q1 of last year, among the average home purchase amount per household in Gangnam's Big 3, proceeds from real estate sales accounted for KRW 565 million (37.6%), the largest share. Demand from those "trading up to higher-grade areas" by leveraging capital gains from selling existing homes is driving the buying trend in Gangnam's Big 3. ( 22일 차규근 조국혁신당 의원실이 국토교통부로부터 제출받은 자금조달계획서(외국인·법인 제외) 자료를 분석해보면, 올해 1분기 강남3구의 한 호당 평균 주택 매수 금액은 약 15억400만원, 노도강은 5억6400만원으로 3배에 가까운 격차를 보였다. 강남3구와 노도강은 거래 규모만큼이나 자금 조달 방식에서도 큰 차이를 보이며 계층화된 시장 구조를 나타냈다. 강남3구는 이미 보유한 자산을 기반으로 더 비싼 주택을 매입하며 ‘갈아타기’를 하는 반면, 노도강은 대출에 의존해 주택을 매입하는 식이다.)

Bank deposits and other cash assets held in financial institutions like securities firms are also a major source of funds for home purchases in Gangnam's Big 3. Homebuyers in these districts procured an average of KRW 299 million (19.9%) per household from financial institution deposits, making it the second-largest funding source. In Nowon-Dobong-Gangbuk, an average of KRW 87 million (15.4%) in cash assets was used. ( 강남3구는 부동산뿐 아니라 예금, 주식 등 다양한 자산을 동원해 주택을 매입하는 모습이 뚜렷하게 나타났다. 지난 1분기 강남3구 주택 매수자들의 한 호당 평균 주택 매수 금액 중에서 부동산 처분 대금은 5억6500만원(37.6%)으로 가장 큰 비중을 차지했다. 기존 주택을 팔아 얻은 시세 차익을 활용하는 ‘상급지 갈아타기’ 수요가 강남3구 매수세를 주도하고 있는 것이다.)

In Gangnam's Big 3, the share of funds from stock and bond sales was notably high. In Q1 of last year, homebuyers in these districts procured an average of KRW 146 million (9.7%) from selling stocks and bonds. In other areas of Seoul, excluding Gangnam's Big 3, the average amount from stock and bond sales used for home purchases was KRW 19 million (4.8%), and in Nowon-Dobong-Gangbuk, it was just KRW 14 million (2.5%). This suggests that the financial income accumulated during an unprecedented rally that quickly reached 9,000 points may have contributed to the purchasing power in Gangnam. ( 은행, 증권사 등에 예치된 현금성 자산을 뜻하는 금융기관 예금액도 강남3구 주택 매수의 주요 자금원이다. 강남3구 주택 매수자들은 한 호당 평균 2억9900만원(19.9%)을 금융기관 예금액으로 조달해, 두번째로 비중이 큰 자금원이었다. 노도강의 경우 현금성 자산은 평균 8700만원(15.4%)이 활용된 것으로 집계됐다.)

Indeed, out of the total KRW 1.3883 trillion raised from stock and bond sales in Seoul's housing market in Q1 of last year, 35.6% (KRW 494.4 billion) was concentrated in Gangnam's Big 3. In Nowon-Dobong-Gangbuk, only 3.9% (KRW 54.2 billion) was procured. Even last year, when the KOSPI began its sharp rise, out of KRW 3.858 trillion in stock and bond sale proceeds used for Seoul home purchases, 41.1% (KRW 1.5848 trillion) was funneled into Gangnam's Big 3, while only 1.8% (KRW 68.1 billion) went to Nowon-Dobong-Gangbuk. ( 강남3구에서는 주식·채권 매각 대금 조달 비중도 유달리 높게 나타났다. 지난 1분기 강남3구 주택 매수자들은 평균 1억4600만원(9.7%)을 주식·채권 매각 대금으로 조달했다. 강남3구를 제외한 서울 지역에서 주택 매수에 활용된 주식·채권 매각 대금은 평균 1900만원(4.8%), 노도강에서는 1400만원(2.5%)에 그쳤다. 단기간에 ‘9천피’에 도달한 역대급 랠리 속에 불어난 금융소득이 강남권 주택 매수 여력으로 이어졌을 가능성을 보여준다.)

"Family support funds" were also a crucial "money source" for home purchases in Gangnam's Big 3. In Q1 of last year, homebuyers in these districts received an average of KRW 105 million (7.0%) in gifts and inheritances and KRW 76 million (5.1%) in "other loans" from family members, totaling about KRW 180 million in family support. This is more than 3.8 times the amounts in Nowon-Dobong-Gangbuk, where gifts and inheritances averaged KRW 25 million (4.4%) and other loans KRW 22 million (3.8%). ( 실제로 지난 1분기 서울 주택시장에 조달된 주식·채권 매각 대금 총 1조3883억원 가운데 35.6%(4944억원)가 강남3구에서 집중됐다. 노도강 지역에서는 3.9%(542억원)가 조달되는 데 그쳤다. 코스피 급등이 시작된 지난해에도 서울 주택 매입에 쓰인 주식·채권 매각 대금 3조8580억원 가운데 41.1%(1조5848억원)가 강남3구에 쏠렸고, 노도강에는 1.8%(681억원)가 조달됐다.)

The foundation of funds for home purchases in Nowon-Dobong-Gangbuk was primarily "mortgage loans." Homebuyers there relied on mortgage loans for 35.0% of their average home purchase price, amounting to KRW 197 million. In contrast, due to loan regulations on high-priced homes, mortgage loan funds in Gangnam's Big 3 were only KRW 152 million (10.1%). So, homebuyers in Nowon-Dobong-Gangbuk purchased homes at roughly one-third the price of those in Gangnam's Big 3 but took out larger mortgage loans than buyers in the latter area. ( ‘가족 지원 자금’도 강남3구 주택 매수의 중요한 ‘돈줄’이었다. 지난 1분기 강남3구 주택 매수자는 평균적으로 증여·상속 1억500만원(7.0%)과 가족 등으로부터 빌린 ‘그 밖의 차입금’ 7600만원(5.1%) 등 1억8천여만원에 이르는 가족 지원을 받은 것으로 나타났다. 노도강의 증여·상속 2500만원(4.4%)과 그 밖의 차입금 2200만원(3.8%)의 3.8배가 넘는 액수다.)

The gap in fund procurement costs between asset-driven Gangnam's Big 3 and loan-dependent Nowon-Dobong-Gangbuk could become more pronounced during a rising interest rate period. With the Bank of Korea likely to raise its benchmark interest rate, the higher loan proportion in Nowon-Dobong-Gangbuk could translate into actual household burdens. Conversely, Gangnam's Big 3, where transactions are based on existing asset sales, are relatively less affected by interest rates and loan regulations. (노도강의 주택 매수에 조달된 자금의 기반은 주로 ‘주택담보대출’이었다. 노도강 주택 매수자들은 평균 주택 매수 금액 가운데 35.0%인 1억9700만원을 주택담보대출에 의존했다. 한편 강남3구는 고가 주택에 대한 대출 규제로 인해 주택담보대출 자금이 1억5200만원(10.1%)에 그쳤다. 노도강 주택 매수자들은 강남3구의 3분의 1 남짓한 가격의 집을 사면서 강남3구 주택 매수자보다 더 큰 규모의 주택담보대출을 받은 셈이다.)

Experts diagnose that within the same Seoul, a market driven by assets and a market driven by credit coexist, widening the gap in home purchasing power. Hong Jeong-hoon, a researcher at the Korea Urban Research Institute, said, "As Seoul's housing market stratifies, in the Gangnam area, buyers appear who purchase high-priced apartments regardless of loan regulations by using family assets and illegal gifts, while in outer areas like Nowon-Dobong-Gangbuk, high loan-dependent transactions are centered on first-time homebuyers." ( 자산을 활용하는 강남3구와 대출에 의존하는 노도강의 자금 조달 비용 격차는 금리 상승기에 더욱 뚜렷해질 수 있다. 한국은행이 기준금리를 인상할 가능성이 높아지고 있는 가운데 대출 비중이 높은 노도강에서는 금리 인상이 실질적인 가계 부담으로 이어질 가능성이 있다. 반면 기존 자산 처분을 기반으로 거래가 이뤄진 강남3구는 상대적으로 금리와 대출 규제 등의 영향이 제한적이다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-hye godot@hani.co.kr ( 전문가들은 같은 서울 안에서도 자산을 기반으로 움직이는 시장과 신용을 기반으로 움직이는 시장이 공존하면서 주택 구매 여력의 격차가 확대되고 있다고 진단했다. 홍정훈 한국도시연구소 연구원은 “서울 주택시장이 계층화하면서 강남권에서는 대출 규제와 관계없이 가족의 자산과 편법 증여 등을 통해 고가 아파트를 구입하는 매수자가 나타나는 반면, 노도강 같은 외곽 지역에서는 생애 최초 주택 매수자들을 중심으로 대출 의존도가 높은 거래가 나타나고 있다”고 말했다.)

item.title: 'Semiconductor Money' That Drives Up Home Prices Widens Wealth Inequality (집값 띄운 ‘반도체 머니’ 자산불평등 더 커진다)
item.description:
<<> Kim, a 33-year-old office worker and newlywed, recently signed a contract to buy an apartment in Paldal-gu, Suwon, Gyeonggi Province, taking out a 400 million won loan after failing to find a suitable jeonse (lump-sum deposit) rental property. Jeonse listings have dried up, and the few available were too expensive. "It's burdensome to pay over 3 million won each month in principal and interest, but seeing home prices soar, I felt anxious that I might never be able to buy a home if I waited," Kim said. He bought the home even at a stretch, driven by a fear of being left behind in the housing market rally. <<> Financial income generated from the stock market rally, fueled by earnings from the semiconductor sector, along with large corporations' massive bonuses, is flowing into the real estate market. Wealthy individuals and high-income earners are using profits from stocks and bonuses to purchase high-priced homes, stoking the real estate market. As the perception that real estate is the ultimate destination for wealth in Korean society is reaffirmed, concerns are emerging that the asset gap between homeowners in key locations in Seoul and the capital area and non-homeowners could widen structurally. <<> An analysis by lawmaker Cha Gyu-geun's office of the Rebuilding Korea Party of fund procurement plans (excluding foreigners and corporations) submitted by the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport shows that in the first quarter (January-March) of this year, proceeds from the sale of stocks and bonds used to purchase homes in Seoul amounted to 1.3883 trillion won, a 43.4% increase from 968.4 billion won in the same quarter a year earlier. The scale of stock and bond sale proceeds flowing into the Seoul real estate market has grown by trillions of won annually, from 1.0427 trillion won in 2023 to 2.2088 trillion won in 2024, and 3.858 trillion won last year. If the KOSPI’s sharp rally in the first quarter of this year enters a consolidation phase, there is a significant risk that a 'money move' from the stock market to the real estate market will accelerate, driven by changes in expected returns. <<> Even when the stock market rises, only a tiny fraction of investors realize capital gains large enough to buy real estate. According to the Korea Securities Depository, as of the end of last year, 60.4% (8.744 million) of all stock investors (14.465 million) held listed stocks worth less than 10 million won. Only 0.5%, or 79,000 people, were 'stock rich,' holding listed stocks worth over 1 billion won, and they accounted for more than half of the total KOSPI market capitalization. Even if the KOSPI continues to hit record highs in a 'bull run,' the resulting financial income is extremely concentrated among a tiny minority of the ultra-wealthy. <<> Bonuses worth hundreds of millions of won in the semiconductor sector are also shaking up the real estate market. Home prices are already surging in areas preferred by workers at semiconductor companies like Samsung Electronics and SK hynix. In terms of cumulative apartment price increases this year, areas like Hwaseong Dongtan (9.6%), Yongin Suji (9.0%), and Seongnam Bundang (7.4%), which are served by semiconductor company shuttle buses and are called 'shuttle zones' (shuttle bus + station area), have far outpaced Seoul (4.5%). The market expects that transactions with payments due in the first quarter of next year, when Samsung Electronics' semiconductor division bonuses are paid following those of SK hynix, will intensify from the second half of this year, funneling funds into the real estate market. <<> In Korean society, real estate is a key channel that 'cements' class divides, going beyond mere asset concentration. As financial income and bonuses of wealthy individuals and high-income earners flow into the real estate market, gaps in real assets widen. In this process, asset values rise to levels unreachable through labor income, further amplifying inequality. "During a period of rapid asset value fluctuations, where opportunities and risks coexist, asset gaps structurally widen," said Professor Jeong Jun-ho of Kangwon National University (Real Estate Studies). "We must be careful that the severity of asset inequality is not obscured by a few success stories." <<> According to KB Real Estate Data Hub, the average sale price of apartments in Seoul last month reached 1.5712 billion won, up 32.7% from two years ago. While homeowners riding the upward cycle of the real estate market reap the benefits of rising asset prices and reinvest them, those who have failed to purchase a home are spending a significant portion of their income on housing costs like monthly rent, increasing concerns that they cannot even take the first step toward building assets. <<> Experts diagnose that Korean society has entered a tipping point of multiple gaps, where wealth accumulation through assets deepens inequality more than wealth accumulation through labor. "Whether one owns assets already determines not just current inequality but life-long opportunities in housing, education, marriage, childbirth, and retirement," said Professor Woo Seok-jin of Myongji University (Economics). "If a path is not created for the wealth generated by the semiconductor boom to flow into redistribution, 2026 will be recorded as the starting year for the widening of asset inequality." <<> Reporter Lee Ji-hye godot@hani.co.kr Reporter Park Soo-ji suji@hani.co.kr Reporter Lim Jae-woo abbado@hani.co.kr ()

item.title: Families Mobilized 2.6 Trillion Won via 'Family Privilege'...Wealth Inheritance Intensified (가족찬스로 2조6천억 동원…‘부의 대물림’ 강화됐다)
item.description:
<<> In the first quarter of this year, funds raised through 'family privileges' such as gifts, inheritances, and loans for purchasing homes in Seoul amounted to 2.6 trillion won. Notably, funding via 'family loans'—which are not subject to taxation—more than doubled in a year. This indicates an observed strengthening of wealth inheritance centered on the Seoul real estate market. <<> According to data from the Fundraising Plan (excluding foreigners and corporations) submitted to the National Assembly by the office of Representative Cha Gyu-geun of the Fatherland Innovation Party from the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, the funds used for purchasing homes in Seoul in the first quarter (January to March) of this year from gifts, inheritances, and loans totaled 2.633 trillion won, a 63.9% increase from 1.6065 trillion won in the same period last year. The proportion of total purchase funds also nearly doubled, rising from 5.7% to 11%. <<> Following strengthened loan regulations and the blocking of gap investments last year, the phenomenon of 'wealth inheritance'—where parents or other family members provide the funds needed to enter the Seoul housing market—has become more pronounced. In 2023, funds from gifts, inheritances, and loans used for home purchases in Seoul totaled 2.1509 trillion won, growing to 3.7599 trillion won in 2024 and 7.2424 trillion won last year. <<> In fact, the age group that most frequently utilizes gifts, inheritances, and loans in the home-buying process is the 30s. In the first quarter, 51.9% of all 'family privilege' funds were raised by those in their 30s, followed by those in their 40s at 23.9%. <<> What is particularly notable is the increase in funds through family loans. While gift and inheritance funds (1.4651 trillion won) grew by 42.9% compared to the same period last year, 'other loans' (1.1679 trillion won)—referring to money borrowed from parents and others—doubled over the same period a year earlier. <<> Approximately 60% of 'other loans' on the Fundraising Plan are identified as funds raised from direct lineal ascendants or descendants. Unlike gifts, loans are not subject to taxation, so they are effectively used in the market as a channel for family financial support or disguised gifts. A common method in the process of transferring wealth between family members is to receive money from parents, write a loan agreement (IOU), and prove repayment of principal and interest to have it recognized as a 'loan, not a gift'. Tips on writing IOUs between parents and children to avoid tax investigations, and tricks like children using their parents' check cards linked to accounts where interest is deposited, are already being shared online. <<> Even methods to borrow parents' money 'interest-free' are openly known. Under tax law, the appropriate interest rate for loans between family members who are special related parties is 4.6% per year, but if the unpaid interest does not exceed 10 million won annually, it is not presumed to be a gift. Reverse-calculating the amount that yields less than 10 million won in annual interest comes to about 217 million won. This means that up to over 400 million won can be borrowed essentially interest-free from both parents. <<> Lee Jeom-ok, Deputy Director of Shinhan Premier Pass Finder, said, "As loan regulations have tightened, making it harder to borrow money from financial institutions, inquiries about using parents' money in the form of loans to buy homes are increasing." She added, "While the National Tax Service's verification is getting stricter day by day, it seems that tax techniques and consulting to prepare for this will also continue to develop." <<> Experts analyze that while income and financial institution loans were once key means of purchasing homes, whether one can mobilize parents' assets has recently emerged as an important variable. Researcher Hong Jeong-hoon of the Korea Urban Research Institute pointed out, "Disguised gifts between families are acting as a factor deepening asset inequality," and added, "In a situation where class inheritance through assets is blatantly occurring, simply blocking loans has its limits. It is necessary to significantly strengthen regulations on disguised gifts." <<> Representative Cha Gyu-geun said, "To ensure that the housing market is a market of fair opportunity, not a 'parent privilege' market, it is necessary to regularly check whether loans are actually being repaid and interest paid, and to more thoroughly verify disguised gifts by linking the Fundraising Plan with the National Tax Service's taxation information." <<> Reporter Lee Ji-hye godot@hani.co.kr ()

item.title: Consumer sentiment improves for second straight month… Expectations of rising home prices grow (소비심리 두 달째 개선…집값 상승 기대감 높아져)
item.description:
The Consumer Sentiment Index, which reflects the economic perceptions and outlook of ordinary households, has improved for two consecutive months. Expectations of rising home prices, particularly in the capital region, have also increased. (일반 가계의 체감 경기와 경기 전망을 보여주는 소비자심리지수가 두 달 연속 개선된 것으로 나타났다. 수도권을 중심으로 집값 상승에 대한 기대감도 높아졌다.)

According to the "June Consumer Survey Results" released by the Bank of Korea on the 23rd, the Consumer Sentiment Index (CCSI) stood at 106.6, up 0.5 points from the previous month. After declining month-on-month in April and then rebounding, it has been on the rise for the second consecutive month. The Bank of Korea explained that "despite the deterioration in perceived economic conditions due to rising prices, optimistic perceptions increased due to strong exports and a stock market rally." ( 한국은행이 23일 발표한 ‘6월 소비자동향 조사 결과’를 보면, 소비자심리지수(CCSI)는 106.6으로 전달보다 0.5포인트 올랐다. 지난 4월 전월 대비 하락했다가 반등한 뒤 두 달째 상승세를 나타냈다. 한은은 “물가 상승에 따른 체감경기 저하에도 수출 호조와 주가 상승으로 낙관적 인식이 증가한 데 따른 것”으로 풀이했다. )

The Bank of Korea's Consumer Sentiment Index is a composite indicator calculated from six major individual indices, including the current economic assessment and future economic outlook, based on a survey of ordinary households. A reading above 100 indicates that sentiment is more optimistic than the long-term average (2003–2025). ( 한은 소비자심리지수는 일반 가계를 대상으로 한 설문조사를 통해 현재경기판단, 향후경기전망 등 6개 주요 개별지수를 종합해 산출한 지표다. 100보다 높으면 장기평균(2003∼2025년)보다 낙관적이라는 뜻이다.)

The current economic assessment index stood at 86, up 3 points from the previous month. The Bank of Korea reported that this appears to be due to robust exports centered on semiconductors and a rise in stock prices. The future economic outlook index (92) fell 1 point compared to the previous month, as concerns over rising loan interest rates and elevated stock price levels had a negative impact, despite expectations of an end to the US-Israel-Iran war. ( 현재경기판단 지수는 86으로 전달보다 3포인트 올랐다. 반도체 중심의 수출 호조, 주가 상승에 따른 것으로 보인다고 한은은 전했다. 향후경기전망 지수(92)는 미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁 종전 기대에도 불구하고 대출금리 상승세, 높아진 주가 수준에 대한 우려가 부정적인 영향을 끼치면서 전월 대비 1포인트 하락한 것으로 나타났다.)

Among the supplementary indicators beyond the six basic ones, the housing price outlook and interest rate level outlook indices notably stood out. The housing price outlook index rose 8 points from the previous month to 120. This index fell from 124 in January to 96 in March this year, then rebounded in April, climbing for the third consecutive month. The Bank of Korea attributed this to "the expansion of the increase in apartment sales and jeonse (long-term deposit rental) prices, centered on the Seoul and Gyeonggi regions." ( 6개 기본지표 외 보조지표 중에선 주택가격전망, 금리수준전망 지수가 두드러지게 높게 나타나 눈길을 끌었다. 주택가격전망지수는 전달보다 8포인트 오른 120으로 조사됐다. 이 지수는 올해 1월 124에서 3월 96으로 떨어졌다가 4월에 반등해 석 달째 상승세를 타고 있다. 한은은 “서울·경기 지역 중심의 아파트 매매·전세 가격 상승 폭 확대에 따른 것”으로 풀이했다. )

The interest rate level outlook index stood at 126, rising 12 points from the previous month. This appears to be due to expectations of a base rate hike and an increase in market interest rates. Financial markets anticipate that the Bank of Korea will begin raising the base rate starting next month. ( 금리수준전망 지수는 126으로 전달보다 12포인트 상승했다. 기준금리 인상 기대와 시장금리 상승에 따른 것으로 보인다. 금융시장에선 한은이 다음 달부터 기준금리 인상에 나설 것으로 내다보고 있다.)

The expected inflation rate for consumer price increases one year ahead remained at 2.8%, unchanged from the previous month. Despite upward factors such as a larger increase in consumer prices and a high exchange rate, it was analyzed that expectations of an end to the Middle East war and anticipated monetary tightening lowered the expected inflation rate. The expected inflation rate three years ahead rose 0.1 percentage point from the previous month to 2.7%, while the five-year rate stayed the same as the previous month at 2.6%. ( 1년 후 소비자물가상승률에 대한 전망을 담은 기대인플레이션율은 2.8%로 전월 수준을 유지했다. 소비자물가 상승 폭 확대, 고환율 같은 상승 요인에도 불구하고 중동전쟁 종전 기대, 통화 긴축 예상이 물가상승 예상치를 낮춘 것으로 분석됐다. 3년 후 기대인플레이션율은 2.7%로 전달보다 0.1%포인트 상승했고, 5년 후는 2.6%로 전월과 동일했다.)

Kim Young-bae, Senior Reporter kimyb@hani.co.kr ( 김영배 선임기자 kimyb@hani.co.kr)

item.title: 'Baggage-free transit' also becomes available in LA and Seattle... Minimum 20 minutes shorter (LA·시애틀에서도 ‘짐 없는 환승’ 가능해져…최소 20분 단축)
item.description:
From the 23rd, passengers will be able to enjoy 'baggage-free transit' at Los Angeles (LA) and Seattle airports in the United States as well. (23일부터 미국 로스앤젤레스(LA) 및 시애틀 공항에서도 승객의 ‘짐 없는 환승’이 가능해진다.)

The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport announced today that the remote screening of checked baggage, currently implemented for transit passengers at Atlanta, Detroit, and Minneapolis airports in the U.S., will also become available at LA and Seattle airports. ( 국토교통부는 현재 미국 애틀랜타·디트로이트·미니애폴리스 공항 환승객을 대상으로 실시 중인 위탁수하물 원격검색이 엘에이 및 시애틀 공항에서도 가능해진다고 이날 밝혔다.)

Going forward, passengers departing from Incheon International Airport and transiting through LA or Seattle will be able to board their connecting flights directly without retrieving their luggage. Previously, passengers had to collect their baggage, go through customs inspections, and then re-check the luggage at the check-in counter of the connecting airline. The Ministry stated, "The transit time, which typically took 90 minutes, is expected to be shortened to 70 minutes, saving at least 20 minutes." ( 앞으로 인천국제공항을 출발해 엘에이 또는 시애틀에서 환승하는 승객은 수하물을 찾지 않고 곧바로 연결편에 탑승할 수 있게 된다. 기존에는 승객이 수하물을 찾은 뒤 세관검사 등을 통과해 다시 환승 항공사 체크인 카운터에서 짐을 맡겨야 했다. 국토부는 “통상 90분 소요됐던 환승 시간이 70분으로 최소 20분 단축될 것으로 예상된다”고 했다.)

This measure follows cooperation between the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS). Korean Air operates 2-3 flights daily on the Incheon-LA route, while Korean Air and Delta Air Lines each operate one flight daily on the Incheon-Seattle route. Last year, approximately 30% of passengers on these routes, or 127,000 people, were transit passengers at LA and Seattle airports. ( 이번 조처는 국토부와 미국 국토안보부(DHS) 협력에 따른 것으로, 인천-엘에이 노선은 대한항공이 하루 2~3편, 인천-시애틀 노선은 대한항공과 델타항공이 각각 하루 1편씩 운항하고 있다. 지난해 해당 노선 이용객 중 엘에이·시애틀 공항 환승객은 약 30%인 12만7천명이었다고 한다.)

Lee Sang-heon, Director of Airport Policy at the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, said, "The expansion of this remote checked baggage screening service will not only enhance security through advanced technology but also improve passenger convenience and contribute to Incheon Airport's global competitiveness." He added, "We will expand this service to major airports in the U.S. and gradually increase the number of participating airlines so that more passengers can benefit." ( 이상헌 국토부 공항정책관은 “이번 위탁수하물 원격검색 확대 시행은 첨단기술을 통한 보안성 제고는 물론 승객 편의 향상과 인천공항의 글로벌 경쟁력에도 기여할 것”이라며 “본 서비스를 미국 내 주요 공항으로 확대하고 참여 항공사도 점진적으로 늘려, 보다 많은 승객이 혜택을 받을 수 있도록 하겠다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Shin Min-jeong shin@hani.co.kr ( 신민정 기자 shin@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Building High-Quality Data with the Focus and Accuracy of People with Developmental Disabilities (발달장애인의 집중력·정확성으로 고품질 데이터 구축)
item.description:
AI Works, an artificial intelligence (AI) solution company where vulnerable groups such as people with developmental disabilities and hearing impairments work together, won the Excellence Award in the Special Category at the 11th Human Technology Awards. AI Works views these individuals not as a “vulnerable group” but as members with their own strengths. The judges evaluated this as a case demonstrating that advancements in AI technology can avoid marginalizing people and instead lead to coexistence and job creation. (발달장애인, 청각장애인 등 취약계층이 함께 일하는 인공지능(AI) 솔루션 기업 ‘에이아이웍스’가 제11회 휴먼테크놀로지어워드 특별부문 우수상을 수상했다. 에이아이웍스는 이들을 ‘취약계층’이 아니라 각자의 강점을 가진 구성원으로 받아들인다. 심사위원들은 인공지능 기술 발전이 사람을 소외시키지 않고 상생과 고용 창출로 이어질 수 있음을 보여준 사례라고 평가했다.)

AI Works started in 2015 with training programs for career-interrupted women to become software testers. When graduates with the training were rejected for jobs due to their age, CEO Yoon Seok-won founded the company directly. The company later expanded its scope to include software testing training for people with developmental disabilities and data labeling projects, and changed its name from Test Works to AI Works. (에이아이웍스는 2015년 경력보유여성을 소프트웨어 테스터로 양성하는 교육에서 출발했다. 교육 수료자들이 나이를 이유로 취업을 거절당한 것을 보고 윤석원 대표가 직접 회사를 설립했다. 이후 발달장애인을 위한 소프트웨어 테스팅 교육과 데이터 라벨링 사업으로 영역을 넓혔고, 사명도 테스트웍스에서 에이아이웍스로 바꿨다.)

What AI Works emphasizes is that the high focus and accuracy of people with developmental disabilities, along with the responsibility and communication skills of career-interrupted women, serve as strengths in building high-quality data. Some employees with developmental disabilities, who specialize in data labeling that requires repetitive and meticulous work, have later expanded their careers to more difficult tasks, such as testing software and models. Currently, about 20 of the total employees are people with disabilities. (에이아이웍스가 강조하는 것은 발달장애인의 높은 집중력과 정확성, 경력보유여성의 책임감과 소통 능력이 고품질 데이터 구축에 강점으로 작용한다는 것이다. 반복적이고 세밀한 작업을 요구하는 데이터 라벨링에 특화된 발달장애인 직원 중에는 이후 소프트웨어와 모델을 테스트하는 고난도 업무로 경력을 넓혀간 사례도 있다. 현재 전체 직원 중 장애인 직원은 약 20명이다.)

CEO Yoon Seok-won stated, “AI Works pursues inclusive AI where no one is marginalized,” adding, “We are developing new job roles suitable for the AI era, designed so that people with disabilities, career-interrupted women, and others can work together based on their respective strengths.” (윤석원 대표는 “에이아이웍스는 누구도 소외되지 않는 포용적 인공지능을 추구한다”며 “인공지능 시대에 맞는 새로운 직무를 개발해 장애인, 경력보유여성 등이 각자의 강점을 바탕으로 함께 일할 수 있도록 설계하고 있다”고 말했다.)

Judge Lee Won-tae evaluated, “As efforts to use AI technology to solve various social issues become more active, AI Works, as a tech-based social venture, is addressing the employment gap problem by creating jobs for vulnerable groups.” Judge Kim Guk-hyun also cited the company as an example of coexistence, highlighting how it demonstrates the human work and job sharing needed in the AI era as reasons for the selection. (이원태 심사위원은 “인공지능 기술을 활용해 다양한 사회문제를 해결하려는 시도가 활발해지는 지금, 기술 기반 소셜벤처인 에이아이웍스는 취약계층의 일자리 창출을 통해 고용격차 문제를 해결하고 있다”고 평가했다. 김국현 심사위원도 상생의 사례로서 인공지능 시대에 필요한 인간의 일과 일자리 나눔을 보여준 점을 선정 이유로 꼽았다.)

Shin Hyo-jin, Senior Researcher at the Hankyoreh Economic and Social Research Institute jinnytree@hani.co.kr (신효진 한겨레경제사회연구원 선임연구원 jinnytree@hani.co.kr)

item.title: AI-Assisted Chest X-Ray Reading... Contributing to Reducing Medical Disparities (AI가 돕는 흉부 엑스레이 판독...의료 격차 해소 기여)
item.description:
'The 11th Human Technology Award User Category Excellence Award' was awarded to 'AIRead-CXR', a chest X-ray reading software developed by medical AI startup Soombit AI. The judges evaluated that it contributes to medical efficiency and narrowing regional gaps by reducing the workload of medical staff while enabling a certain level of reading support in areas lacking radiologists. (의료 인공지능(AI) 스타트업 숨빗에이아이가 개발한 흉부 엑스레이 판독 소프트웨어 ‘에어리드 씨엑스알(AIRead-CXR)’이 제11회 휴먼테크놀로지어워드 이용자부문 우수상을 수상했다. 심사위원들은 의료진의 업무 부담을 줄이는 동시에 영상의학과 전문의가 부족한 지역에서도 일정 수준의 판독 지원이 가능해진다는 점에서, 의료 효율성과 지역 격차 해소에 기여한다고 평가했다.)

South Korea is considered one of the countries with the highest per capita number of X-ray and CT scans worldwide. Due to an aging population and advances in medical technology, demand for imaging tests is expected to continue to grow, but there is a shortage of radiologists to read them. Soombit AI's AIRead-CXR is an attempt to solve this problem using generative AI technology. (한국은 1인당 엑스레이, 컴퓨터단층촬영(CT) 촬영 횟수가 세계적으로 많은 나라로 꼽힌다. 고령화와 의료기술 발전으로 영상 검사 수요는 앞으로도 늘어날 전망이지만, 이를 판독할 영상의학과 전문의 인력은 부족하다. 숨빗에이아이 에어리드 씨엑스알은 이 문제를 생성형 인공지능 기술로 풀고자 한 시도다.)

AIRead-CXR analyzes chest X-ray images to automatically generate draft reading reports similar to those written by radiologists. Instead of writing reports from scratch, specialists review and edit the AI-generated drafts. Rather than functioning like a chatbot where users input sentences to obtain answers, it only receives and analyzes chest X-ray images, thereby reducing variability in results based on input and ensuring consistency in readings. (에어리드 씨엑스알은 흉부 엑스레이 영상을 분석해 영상의학과 전문의가 작성하는 것과 유사한 판독문 초안을 자동 생성한다. 전문의는 처음부터 판독문을 작성하는 대신 인공지능이 만든 초안을 검토 후 수정하는 방식으로 진행한다. 챗봇처럼 사용자가 문장을 입력해 답을 유도하는 방식이 아니라 흉부 엑스레이 영상만 입력받아 분석하기 때문에, 입력에 따라 결과가 달라질 여지를 줄이고 판독의 일관성을 확보했다.)

Baewoong, CEO of Soombit AI, explained, "It covers the various patient positions that appear when taking chest X-rays within its analysis range and can handle most of the findings that radiologists need to identify." He added, "We have a vision of exporting our self-developed AI model in the medical field." (배웅 숨빗에이아이 대표는 “흉부 엑스레이를 촬영할 때 나타나는 환자들의 다양한 자세를 모두 분석 범위에 포함하고 있으며, 영상의학과 전문의가 찾아야 하는 소견 대부분을 다룰 수 있다”고 설명했다. 그는 “의료 분야에서 자체 개발한 인공지능 모델을 수출하는 비전을 갖고 있다”고 덧붙였다.)

In November 2024, AIRead-CXR became the first generative AI-based medical device software in South Korea to receive approval for a clinical trial plan. In April 2025, it obtained U.S. FDA clinical trial approval, and in April of this year, it received Class 3 medical device certification from the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety. Although there are generative AI-based medical devices in Europe, this marks the first instance of a standalone product that analyzes medical images directly to draft reports receiving national medical device certification. (에어리드 씨엑스알은 2024년 11월 생성형 인공지능 기반 의료기기 소프트웨어로는 국내 최초로 임상시험계획서 승인을 받았고, 2025년 4월 미국 식품의약국(FDA) 임상시험 승인을 거쳐 올해 4월 식품의약품안전처로부터 3등급 의료기기 인허가를 획득했다. 유럽에도 생성형 인공지능 기반 의료기기가 있지만, 의료 영상을 직접 분석해 판독 초안을 작성하는 단독형 제품이 국가 의료기기 인허가를 받은 것은 이번이 첫 사례다.)

Judge Baeyoung stated, "It stands out for reducing the reading burden on radiologists while enabling rapid reading support in areas with a shortage of medical personnel or in emergency situations," and added, "It aligns with the award's purpose of technology for people." (배영 심사위원은 “영상의학과 전문의의 판독 부담을 줄이면서도 의료 인력이 부족한 지역이나 응급 상황에서 신속한 판독 지원이 가능하도록 한 점이 돋보인다”며 “사람을 위한 기술이라는 어워드의 취지에 부합한다”고 선정 이유를 밝혔다.)

Senior Researcher Shin Hyo-jin, Hankyoreh Economic and Social Research Institute jinnytree@hani.co.kr (신효진 한겨레경제사회연구원 선임연구원 jinnytree@hani.co.kr)

item.title: AI integrates and analyzes medical data, catching even severe diseases early (AI로 의료 데이터 종합·분석...중증 질환도 조기에 잡아낸다)
item.description:
The 11th Human Technology Award's User Category Excellence Award went to the Future Medicine Research Institute at Samsung Medical Center, which combines medical big data and artificial intelligence (AI) to innovate the entire medical process from diagnosis to treatment. (제11회 휴먼테크놀로지어워드 이용자부문 우수상은 의료 빅데이터와 인공지능(AI)을 결합해 진단부터 치료까지 의료 과정의 혁신을 시도하는 삼성서울병원 미래의학연구원에게 돌아갔다.)

The Future Medicine Research Institute began as the 'Samsung Biomedical Research Institute' with the opening of Samsung Medical Center in 1994 and was launched in its current form in 2011. It has developed core research areas including genome-based precision medicine, cell and gene therapy-based regenerative medicine, medical big data, and AI-centered convergence medicine. In 2019, it established an 'AI Research Center,' expanding its scope to integrate and analyze medical information, genomic data, and daily life information. (미래의학연구원은 1994년 삼성서울병원 개원과 함께 ‘삼성생명과학연구소’로 시작해 2011년 현재의 형태로 출범했다. 유전체 기반의 정밀의학, 세포유전자치료 기반의 재생의학, 의료빅데이터, 인공지능 중심의 융합의학을 핵심 연구 분야로 키워왔다. 2019년에는 ‘AI연구센터’를 신설해 의료정보, 유전체 정보, 일상 생활정보를 통합 분석하는 연구로 영역을 넓혀왔다.)

The institute's technology is being validated in actual patient treatment and industrialization phases. After being selected in 2021 for the Ministry of Health and Welfare's research-oriented hospital project, 'Future Patient-Centered K-DEM (Korea-Digital & Electronic Medicine) Establishment Project,' numerous medical devices enabling simultaneous information collection and treatment in daily life have been developed, such as AI-based therapeutic robots for pediatric cancer pain control, digital therapeutic devices for sleep disorders, and virtual reality-based depression treatment devices. Efforts are also underway to implement precision oncology through the construction of cancer genome and single-cell analysis databases, as well as to build genome and phenotype databases for rare, intractable genetic diseases. These accumulated research outcomes are being commercialized through collaborations with many startups and biotech companies. (미래의학연구원의 기술력은 실제 환자 치료와 산업화 단계에서 검증되고 있다. 2021년 보건복지부의 연구중심병원 사업인 ‘미래형 환자중심 K-DEM(Korea-Digital & Electronic Medicine) 구축 사업’에 선정된 이후, 소아암 통증조절을 위한 인공지능 기반 치료 로봇, 수면장애 치료용 디지털 치료기기, 가상현실 기반 우울증 치료기기 등 일상생활에서 정보 수집과 치료가 동시에 가능한 의료기기들이 다수 개발됐다. 암 유전체와 단일세포 분석 데이터베이스 구축을 통한 암 정밀의학 구현, 희귀 난치 유전질환의 유전체, 표현형 데이터베이스 구축도 함께 추진 중이다. 이렇게 축적된 연구 성과는 다수의 창업기업, 바이오기업과의 협력으로 이어져 실용화되고 있다.)

Huh Wooseong, Director of the Future Medicine Research Institute (Professor of Nephrology), emphasized, "The introduction of AI into the medical field means a shift in the existing medical paradigm," adding, "We must quickly enter areas and systems that provide practical help to patients." He cited mental illness as a representative area where this paradigm shift is occurring. The director stated, "Mental illnesses such as depression, panic disorder, and anxiety don't end with a doctor's visit in the clinic; they require continuous management in daily life, and AI can provide significant assistance in this area." (허우성 미래의학연구원장(신장내과 교수)은 “인공지능이 의료 현장에 들어온다는 것은 기존의 의료 패러다임이 바뀐다는 의미”라며 “환자에게 실질적으로 도움이 되는 분야와 시스템에 빠르게 진입해야 한다”고 강조했다. 그는 이런 패러다임 전환이 일어나는 대표적인 영역으로 정신질환을 꼽았다. 허 원장은 “우울증, 공황장애, 불안증 등 정신질환은 진료실에서 의사를 만나는 것으로 끝나지 않고 일상생활에서 지속적인 관리가 필요한데, 이 영역에서 인공지능이 큰 도움을 줄 수 있다”고 말했다.)

Review committee member Chae Baek-ryun assessed, "It is impressive that AI integrates and analyzes diverse medical data—such as imaging (CT, MRI), lab values, genetic data, and electronic medical records—leading the entire process from early diagnosis of severe diseases to predicting deterioration in hospitalized patients." (채백련 심사위원은 “영상(컴퓨터단층촬영, 자기공명영상장치), 검사 수치, 유전자 데이터, 전자의무기록 등 다양한 의료 데이터를 인공지능이 통합 분석해 중증 질환 조기진단부터 입원 환자의 악화 예측까지 전 과정을 주도하고 있는 점이 인상적”이라고 평가했다.)

Shin Hyo-jin, Senior Researcher at the Hankyoreh Economic and Social Research Institute jinnytree@hani.co.kr (신효진 한겨레경제사회연구원 선임연구원 jinnytree@hani.co.kr)

item.title: History Beyond the Textbook: Ajou University Students Document the 'Hidden Modern and Contemporary History' of Local Seniors (교과서 밖으로 나온 역사학... 아주대 학생들이 기록한 지역 어르신의 ‘숨은 근현대사’)
item.description:
The Department of History at Ajou University has introduced a novel approach, using its 'Modern and Contemporary Korean History' course (supervised by Professor Han Sang-woo) to record the life stories of local seniors into autobiographies. This effort is praised as a practice of history’s true value by connecting the grand narratives of textbooks with the concrete lives of individuals in the field.
The activity was conducted in collaboration with the senior center of Suwon's Woncheon Jugong Apartment, located across from Ajou University's campus. Under the guidance of Professor Han Sang-woo of the Department of History, 38 students were divided into 11 groups, conducting in-depth interviews with 11 seniors, including members of the senior center, from mid-March to late May over about two and a half months. The students not only listened to and recorded the seniors' stories but also photographed their personal collections and photographs, based on which they organized transcripts and drafted autobiographies.
Notably, the active use of artificial intelligence (AI) in the autobiography production process drew attention. Students utilized AI to organize interview content, refine the tone of oral materials, design covers, and create images. Rather than relying entirely on AI outputs, students took the lead by rigorously cross-checking and supplementing facts against the original transcripts. This approach demonstrates the students' sincerity in ensuring the accuracy of historical records while embracing technological convenience, serving as an opportunity to confirm the proper use of AI in humanities education.
Through an intense semester-long process, a total of 11 different autobiographies were produced. The autobiography project received support from Ajou University's Anchor (formerly RISE, Regional Innovation-Centered University Support System) 'Dynamic-PBL Course Operation Support Project', and 150 printed copies were delivered directly to the participating seniors in mid-June. Kim Young-mi, president of the Woncheon Jugong Apartment Senior Association, who received the autobiographies, expressed her gratitude to the students, saying, "It was touching to have one's individual life valued as historically significant." In response, Kim Min-seo, a student in the History Department who participated in the project, shared her thoughts: "It was a special moment to vividly witness that behind the history we only encounter in books, individual lives that quietly endured that era with all their might are still breathing."
With this model that connected university major education to the local community and fostered intergenerational communication, the Department of History at Ajou University plans to continue expanding various field-linked educational initiatives based on historical knowledge and methods to contribute to the local community. (아주대학교 사학과가 ‘한국근현대사’ 전공 수업(지도교수 한상우)을 통해 지역 어르신들의 생애사를 자서전으로 기록하는 신선한 시도를 선보였다. 교과서 속 거대 역사와 개인의 구체적인 삶을 연결하는 역사학의 진정한 가치를 현장에서 실천했다는 평가다.
이번 활동은 아주대 캠퍼스 맞은편에 위치한 수원시 원천주공아파트 경로당과 연계하여 진행됐다. 아주대학교 사학과 한상우 교수의 지도로 수강생 38명의 학생은 11개 조로 나뉘어 지난 3월 중순부터 5월 말까지 약 두 달 반 동안 경로당 회원을 비롯한 11명의 어르신을 대상으로 심층 인터뷰를 진행했다. 학생들은 어르신들의 이야기를 직접 듣고 녹취하는 것은 물론, 개인 소장 자료와 사진까지 촬영해 이를 바탕으로 녹취록을 정리하고 자서전 원고를 작성했다.
특히 자서전 제작 과정에서 인공지능(AI)을 적극적으로 도입한 점이 눈길을 끈다. 학생들은 인터뷰 내용 정리와 구술 자료의 문체 다듬기, 표지 디자인 및 이미지 제작 등에 AI를 활용했다. AI의 결과물에 전적으로 의존하기보다, 학생들이 직접 원본 녹취록과 일일이 대조하며 사실관계를 엄격하게 검토하고 보완하는 주도적인 노력을 기울였다. 이는 기술의 편리함을 수용하면서도 역사 기록의 정확성을 확보하기 위한 학생들의 진정성이 더해진 결과로, 인문학 교육 영역에서 AI의 올바른 활용 가능성을 확인하는 계기가 됐다.
한 학기동안 진행된 치열한 과정을 거쳐 총 11종의 자서전 결과물이 탄생했다. 자서전 제작은 아주대 앵커(舊 RISE, 지역혁신중심 대학지원체계) 사업의 「Dynamic-PBL 교과목 운영 지원사업」 지원을 받았으며 인쇄된 150권은 지난 6월 중순 어르신들에게 직접 전달됐다. 자서전을 전달받은 원천주공아파트 노인회 김영미 회장은 “개인의 삶을 역사적 가치로 평가받은 것 같아 감동적이었다”며 학생들에게 감사를 전했다. 이에 프로젝트에 참여한 김민서(사학과) 학생도 “책으로만 접한 역사 뒤에, 묵묵히 그 시대를 온몸으로 버텨낸 개인의 삶이 숨 쉬고 있음을 생생하게 목격한 것은 특별한 순간이었다”고 소감을 밝혔다.
아주대 사학과는 대학 전공 교육을 지역사회와 연결하여 세대 간 소통을 이끌어낸 이번 모델을 계기로, 앞으로도 역사학의 지식과 방법을 바탕으로 지역사회에 기여할 수 있는 다양한 현장 연계형 교육을 지속적으로 확대해 나갈 계획이다.)

<This article is an informational piece provided by Ajou University and may differ from the views of The Hankyoreh.> (<이 기사는 아주대학교에서 제공한 정보기사로 한겨레의 의견과 다를 수 있습니다.>)
